description: In front of you is a small white square table-like base sitting on a green surface, with several upright rectangular legs/posts attached to it. The left hand reaches in from the left, grips the nearest upright post on the base as a left-hand object, pulls it upward to loosen it, then lifts it off and carries it leftward before setting it down on the surface, while the right hand stays resting near the base without grasping anything.
